title: Your Love Horoscope Is Here For Thursday, August 27: A Much-Needed Moment Of Closure Arrives - NewsBreak
text:
By Kate Rose ,
2 hours ago Design: YourTango | Photo: Tursk Aleksandra, Shutterstock On August 27, retrograde Neptune in Aries aligns with retrograde Pluto in Aquarius, once again highlighting the theme of this week (which is seeing the truth of your romantic life) in every zodiac sign's love horoscope for Thursday.
There is a powerful shift in the collective this week that is requiring you to break through any illusions and free yourself to move forward more authentically . All of this is occurring in the lead-up to the Full Moon Lunar Eclipse in Pisces tomorrow, which is about completion. Choose the truth today. Setting yourself free from situations that take away your peace or don’t honor what you deserve creates the space for what (or who) will.
Love horoscopes for Thursday, August 27, 2026: Aries Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango Create space for yourself on Thursday. Try to take some time to be alone so that you don’t miss the chance to see yourself and your relationships in a new light.
The answers you're looking for aren’t going to be found in having another conversation with your partner or someone else. They will only be found within yourself. But you need space and some quiet time to really get the chance to actually see what's really going on.
This week is bringing about a new cycle in your life, Aries. But only if you lean into seeing the truth.
RELATED: 4 Zodiac Signs See Life Permanently Change By The End Of August 2026
Taurus Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango You don’t have to pretend to be perfectly healed. Healing isn’t something that is done once and then forgotten about. Nor is it something that you actually ever reach the end of.
Practice grace for yourself on August 27. Honor the wounds you’re still healing from, as that awareness will change how you approach your romantic life. What you need is an equal partner , not someone who will keep hurting you in the ways you’re already used to.
RELATED: Karmic Tests & Challenges Are Finally Over For 4 Zodiac Signs, According To An Astrologer
Gemini Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango The truth isn’t always easy to accept, Gemini. But that doesn’t mean it’s not valuable.
On August 27, you are being asked to face an uncomfortable truth about a relationship in your life so that you can finally move forward. This relationship could be romantic, but it could just as easily be about someone in your family or even one of your friends.
Regardless, it is deeply entrenched in the choices you’ve been making for yourself. Sometimes, the only thing you can do is accept everything as it is so that you can take a step forward.
RELATED: Much-Deserved Success Arrives For 4 Zodiac Signs During The Summer 2026 Eclipse Season
Cancer Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango It doesn’t matter how good or appropriate your relationship looks on the outside if it doesn’t actually align with your needs or desires, Cancer.
Be prepared for a wake-up call on August 27. The universe wants you to start honoring your authentic spirit and what it means to cultivate a relationship that honors all of who you are.
On Thursday, make the choice that’s best for you. Don’t give up on your own special kind of happily ever after.
RELATED: 5 Zodiac Signs Are Attracting Happiness & Love While Venus Is In Libra From Now Until September 10
Leo Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango True love doesn't require pretending, Leo. You are embarking on a brand new path in your life that requires full and total authenticity and truth. But this means that you also must cease performing or trying to prove anything .
If you’re always trying to play a certain role for yourself or others, it's a lot harder to actually feel the kind of love you want. Before you make any choices about the future, let yourself start honoring the truth of how you feel and the relationships in your life.
RELATED: 4 Zodiac Signs Are Being Blessed Financially For The Rest Of 2026
Virgo Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango The truth doesn’t always arrive gently, Virgo. The more that you resist seeing what the universe is trying to reveal, the more difficult everything will feel.
You have had opportunities to awaken to the truth of a romantic dynamic in your life. But up to this point, you’ve fought it every step of the way.
No matter what else you do or try, you won’t be able to change the outcome. On August 27, accept this truth and relationship for what it is so you can start seeing all the possibilities that surround you.
RELATED: The Zodiac Sign Making The Greatest Comeback In August 2026 After Struggling For Years
Libra Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango You can only give so many second chances. You have a big heart, Libra. And there really isn’t anything you love more than love itself. However, someone in your life is taking advantage of your loving and forgiving nature .
All relationships have challenges, but that doesn’t mean you should find yourself giving out endless chances for this person to actually start loving you right. Be willing to choose yourself on Thursday. That is how you will be able to meet the kind of love you actually deserve.
RELATED: 4 Zodiac Signs Attract Deep, Fulfilling Love By The End Of Summer 2026
Scorpio Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango Change is always a little scary , Scorpio. No matter how much you want to choose a new beginning or opportunity, that doesn’t mean you won’t be scared.
When it comes down to it, remember that being scared means that whatever you’re about to do is important to you. Which is why you can’t let yourself change your mind on Thursday.
The person you love, as well as your family and friends, will still be here for you, but right now is your chance to spread your wings and fly a bit. Experience life knowing you will always have a home to return to.
RELATED: Good Things Fall Into Place For 3 Chinese Zodiac Signs During The Month Of August 2026
Sagittarius Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango August 27 brings about a sudden shift of events. You find yourself doing something that you never expected.
The universe is once again trying to get you to see the truth of your romantic life, Sagittarius. This can be in regard to a relationship you’ve always committed to, or one that you’re secretly hoping to.
Once you accept this truth, you will be reaching out to that special person who has your heart. Try to keep up! Everything is about to start changing quite rapidly.
RELATED: 3 Chinese Zodiac Signs Attract Wealth & Success All Month In August 2026
Capricorn Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango It feels like you’ve been taken advantage of recently. Someone in your life thinks no matter what happens, you will always be there.
You aren’t just here for the benefit of others, Capricorn. While the roots of your life are important, you also have to recognize that you are here for a greater purpose .
This doesn’t mean you should go running toward new horizons, but you do wanna make sure that you’re also honoring what you deserve from life. Choosing yourself and choosing the love you want can be the same thing.
RELATED: Life Is Finally Getting Easier For 2 Zodiac Signs After 2 Long Years Of Struggles & Setbacks
Aquarius Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango Once you let go, Aquarius, everything starts to get easier. On August 27, let go of how you thought all of this would turn out. Release the past promises you’ve made and rethink the commitments that you agreed to.
You are being guided to let go of what you thought was real so that you can free yourself to find what is. This is the start of a chapter that will bring incredible new opportunities and love into your life, but you have to first free yourself from what has you trapped in place .
RELATED: Things Finally Come Together For 5 Zodiac Signs By The End Of August 2026
Pisces Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango Trust yourself and your ability to notice both the red and green flags in a relationship. While you’ve done all the work, you haven’t actually put it into practice as of yet.
As a soul connection enters your life on Thursday, it's important that you don’t let fear rule your decisions. Trust yourself. Take this slow and let yourself fall deep in love.
